title: Core Parameters v3.6
content_markdown:
# Core Parameters v3.6

Global parameters that can be set in configuration file. Accepted values are, depending on the actual parameters strings, numbers and yes/ no. If you need to specify either "yes" or "no" as part of a string, wrap this in double quotes.

### 1.1 abort_on_assert
Default value: false
Only relevant if asserts are enabled. Set to true in order to make OpenSIPS shut down immediately in case a script assert fails.

### 1.2 advertised_address
It can be an IP address or string and represents the address advertised in Via header and other destination lumps (e.g RR header). If empty or not set (default value) the socket address from where the request will be sent is used.

### 1.4 alias
Parameter to set alias hostnames for the server. It can be set many times, each value being added in a list to match the hostname when 'myself' is checked.

### 1.72 socket
Set the network addresses/sockets the OpenSIPS server should listen on. Its syntax is protocol:address[:port|portrange].

parameters.name: abort_on_assert
parameters.description: Only relevant if asserts are enabled. Set to true in order to make OpenSIPS shut down immediately in case a script assert fails.

examples.description: Enable immediate shutdown on assert failure

parameters.name: advertised_address
parameters.description: It can be an IP address or string and represents the address advertised in Via header and other destination lumps (e.g RR header). If empty or not set (default value) the socket address from where the request will be sent is used.

parameters.name: advertised_port
parameters.description: The port advertised in Via header and other destination lumps (e.g. RR). If empty or not set (default value) the port from where the message will be sent is used.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Parameter to set alias hostnames for the server. It can be set many times, each value being added in a list to match the hostname when 'myself' is checked.

parameters.name: auto_aliases
parameters.description: This parameter controls if aliases should be automatically discovered and added during fixing listening sockets.

parameters.name: auto_scaling_cycle
parameters.description: The number of seconds defining a auto-scaling cycle - the auto-scaling engine, at each cycle, is evaluating the internal load of the groups.

examples.description: Set auto-scaling check to every 3 seconds

parameters.name: auto_scaling_profile
parameters.description: Defines the behavior of the auto-scaling support, in terms of how many processes should be allowed and when to terminate or create new processes.

examples.code: auto_scaling_profile = PROFILE_SIP\n scale up to 6 on 70% for 4 cycles within 5\n scale down to 2 on 18% for 10 cycles

parameters.name: check_via
parameters.description: Check if the address in top most via of replies is local.

parameters.name: chroot
parameters.description: The value must be a valid path in the system. If set, OpenSIPS will chroot to its value.

parameters.name: debug_mode
parameters.description: Enabling the debug_mode option is a fast way to debug your OpenSIPS. Forces foreground, log level 4, core dumping, and limited workers.

parameters.name: db_version_table
parameters.description: The name of the table version to be used by the DB API to check the version of the used tables.

parameters.name: db_default_url
parameters.description: The default DB URL to be used by modules if no per-module URL is given.

parameters.name: db_max_async_connections
parameters.description: Maximum number of TCP connections opened from a single OpenSIPS worker to each individual SQL backend.

parameters.name: disable_503_translation
parameters.description: If 'yes', OpenSIPS will not translate the received 503 replies into 500 replies.

parameters.name: disable_core_dump
parameters.description: Set this config variable to 'yes' to disable core dump-ing.

parameters.name: disable_dns_blacklist
parameters.description: Controls if the DNS resolver should automatically store failed destinations in a temporary blacklist.

parameters.name: disable_dns_failover
parameters.description: Set this config variable to 'yes' to disable the DNS-based failover.

parameters.name: disable_stateless_fwd
parameters.description: Controls the handling of stateless replies.

parameters.name: dns
parameters.description: Controls if the SIP server should attempt to lookup its own domain name in DNS.

examples.description: Enable DNS lookup for own domain

parameters.name: dns_retr_time
parameters.description: Time in seconds before retrying a dns request.

parameters.name: dns_retr_no
parameters.description: Number of dns retransmissions before giving up.

parameters.name: dns_servers_no
parameters.description: How many dns servers from the ones defined in '/etc/resolv.conf' will be used.

parameters.name: dns_try_ipv6
parameters.description: If set to 'yes' and a DNS lookup fails, it will retry it for ipv6 (AAAA record).

parameters.name: dns_try_naptr
parameters.description: Disables the NAPTR lookups when doing DNS based routing for SIP requests.

parameters.name: dns_use_search_list
parameters.description: If set to 'no', the search list in '/etc/resolv.conf' will be ignored.

parameters.name: dst_blacklist
parameters.description: Definition of a IP/destination blacklist for filtering outgoing requests.

parameters.name: enable_asserts
parameters.description: Set to true in order to enable the assert script statement.

parameters.name: event_pkg_threshold
parameters.description: Percentage threshold above which the E_CORE_PKG_THRESHOLD event is raised.

parameters.name: event_shm_threshold
parameters.description: Percentage threshold above which the E_CORE_SHM_THRESHOLD event is raised.

parameters.name: exec_dns_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum number of microseconds a DNS query is expected to last before triggering a warning.

parameters.name: exec_msg_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum number of microseconds the processing of a SIP msg is expected to last before triggering a warning.

parameters.name: include_file
parameters.description: Load additional routes/blocks from a file.

parameters.name: import_file
parameters.description: Same as include_file.

parameters.name: log_event_enabled
parameters.description: Enables the triggering of the E_CORE_LOG event for every log message.

parameters.name: log_event_level_filter
parameters.description: Extra log level filtering for the E_CORE_LOG event.

parameters.name: log_json_buf_size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer used for printing the JSON document corresponding to a log message.

parameters.name: log_level
parameters.description: Set the logging level (how verbose OpenSIPS should be).

parameters.name: log_msg_buf_size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer used for printing the log message's payload.

parameters.name: log_stdout
parameters.description: Enables passing through all standard output logs.

parameters.name: log_prefix
parameters.description: A string prefix which will be prepended to all logs produced by OpenSIPS.

parameters.name: max_while_loops
parameters.description: Maximum loops that can be done within a "while" to avoid infinite loops.

parameters.name: maxbuffer
parameters.description: Size in bytes not to be exceeded during auto-probing of maximum UDP buffer size.

parameters.name: mem-group
parameters.description: Defines a group of modules to get separate memory statistics.

examples.description: Define memory group for core and tm

parameters.name: mem_warming
parameters.description: If set to "on", OpenSIPS will attempt to restore the memory fragmentation pattern it had before the stop/restart.

parameters.name: mem_warming_percentage
parameters.description: How much of OpenSIPS's memory should be fragmented with the pattern of the previous run.

parameters.name: mem_warming_pattern_file
parameters.description: File containing the memory fragmentation pattern of a previous OpenSIPS run.

parameters.name: memdump
parameters.description: Log level to print memory status information.

parameters.name: memlog
parameters.description: Log level to print memory debug info.

parameters.name: mcast_loopback
parameters.description: If set to 'yes', multicast datagram are sent over loopback.

parameters.name: mcast_ttl
parameters.description: Set the value for multicast ttl.

parameters.name: mhomed
parameters.description: Set the server to try to locate outbound interface on multihomed host.

parameters.name: mpath
parameters.description: Set the module search path.

parameters.name: open_files_limit
parameters.description: Try to increase the open file limit to this number.

parameters.name: poll_method
parameters.description: The poll method to be used by the I/O internal reactor.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port the SIP server listens to.

parameters.name: pv_print_buf_size
parameters.description: The maximum size of an expanded formatted string containing variables.

parameters.name: query_buffer_size
parameters.description: If > 1, inserts to DB will be buffered until this size is reached.

parameters.name: query_flush_time
parameters.description: Timer to flush buffered DB queries.

parameters.name: restart_persistency_cache_file
parameters.description: Name of the cache file used to store restart persistence memory.

parameters.name: restart_persistency_size
parameters.description: Size of the restart persistency cache file.

parameters.name: rev_dns
parameters.description: Controls if the SIP server should attempt to lookup its own IP address in DNS.

parameters.name: server_header
parameters.description: Body of Server header field generated by OpenSIPS as UAS.

parameters.name: server_signature
parameters.description: Controls the "Server" header in any locally generated message.

parameters.name: shm_hash_split_percentage
parameters.description: Controls how many memory buckets will be optimized in HP_MALLOC.

parameters.name: shm_memlog_size
parameters.description: Configures the maximum number of shm operations to keep in the in-memory history.

parameters.name: shm_secondary_hash_size
parameters.description: Optimization factor of a single bucket in HP_MALLOC.

parameters.name: sip_warning
parameters.description: If set to 1, a 'Warning' header is added to each reply generated by OpenSIPS.

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: Set the network addresses/sockets the OpenSIPS server should listen on.

parameters.name: stderror_enabled
parameters.description: Enables writing log messages to standard error.

parameters.name: stderror_level_filter
parameters.description: Extra log level filtering for messages written to standard error.

parameters.name: syslog_enabled
parameters.description: Enables writing log messages to syslog.

parameters.name: stderror_log_format
parameters.description: Format of the log messages printed to standard error.

parameters.name: syslog_facility
parameters.description: Control the facility for syslog logging.

parameters.name: syslog_level_filter
parameters.description: Extra log level filtering for messages sent to syslog.

parameters.name: syslog_log_format
parameters.description: Format of the log messages sent to syslog.

parameters.name: syslog_name
parameters.description: Set the id to be printed in syslog.

parameters.name: tcp_workers
parameters.description: Number of worker processes to be created for reading from TCP connections.

parameters.name: tcp_accept_aliases
parameters.description: Enforce RFC 5923 behaviour for TCP connection reusage.

parameters.name: tcp_connect_timeout
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds before an ongoing blocking attempt to connect will be aborted.

parameters.name: tcp_connection_lifetime
parameters.description: Lifetime in seconds for TCP sessions.

parameters.name: tcp_max_connections
parameters.description: Maximum number of active TCP accepted connections.

parameters.name: tcp_max_msg_time
parameters.description: Maximum number of seconds that a SIP message is expected to arrive via TCP.

parameters.name: tcp_no_new_conn_bflag
parameters.description: Branch flag to instruct OpenSIPS not to open a new TCP connection.

parameters.name: tcp_no_new_conn_rplflag
parameters.description: Message flag for preventing OpenSIPS to open a new TCP connection for replies.

parameters.name: tcp_parallel_read_on_workers
parameters.description: Allow a TCP conn to perform read operations from different processes.

parameters.name: tcp_socket_backlog
parameters.description: Maximum length of the queue of pending connections for TCP listening sockets.

parameters.name: tcp_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum number of microseconds sending of a TCP request is expected to last.

parameters.name: tcp_keepalive
parameters.description: Enable or disable TCP keepalive (OS level).

parameters.name: tcp_keepcount
parameters.description: Number of keepalives to send before closing the connection.

parameters.name: tcp_keepidle
parameters.description: Amount of time before OpenSIPS will start to send keepalives if the connection is idle.

parameters.name: tcp_keepinterval
parameters.description: Interval between keepalive probes, if the previous one failed.

parameters.name: timer_workers
parameters.description: Number of worker processes to be created exclusively for timer related tasks.

parameters.name: tos
parameters.description: The TOS (Type Of Service) to be used for the sent IP packages.

parameters.name: udp_workers
parameters.description: Number of worker processes to be created for each UDP or SCTP interface.

parameters.name: user_agent_header
parameters.description: Body of User-Agent header field generated by OpenSIPS as UAC.

parameters.name: wdir
parameters.description: The working directory used by OpenSIPS at runtime.

parameters.name: xlog_buf_size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer used to print a single line on the logging facility.

parameters.name: xlog_force_color
parameters.description: Enables the use of the color escape sequences in xlog.

parameters.name: xlog_level
parameters.description: Independently controls the verbosity of the xlog() functions.

parameters.name: xlog_print_level
parameters.description: Default level for printing logs generated by xlog core function when log_level is omitted.
